messages.subject: For Jensen Huang | AI infrastructure, government relations and global stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear NVIDIA Corporate Communications Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Jensen Huang, Founder and Chief Executive Officer.

NVIDIA's global leadership in AI infrastructure increasingly intersects with governments, data-center investment, energy systems, sovereign technology priorities and strategic partners. That stakeholder environment closely matches my current leadership responsibilities.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior institutional engagement across complex regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, strategic partnerships and emerging-market stakeholder execution might support NVIDIA's international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to NVIDIA.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
